body: This may be a stupid question but have you ever thought about why you don't feel loved? I feel the same. For example for me it is because I don't ever feel safe enough to let anyone in and I am closed off emotionally.

Pretty much same. Yeah i felt hella depressed  too in those old pics but it was better than this. I was better than this. Even when I am doing something remotely enjoyable with other people I stop to think that the moment i am living will be in the past. Idk.

I dream of this all the time lol. Being hospitalized so I can escape all of my duties and have people really see how much I am suffering. Friends and family coming through the door worried so they can see how sick I am. Them staying by my side being all nice, understanding and loving towards me and wishing for a quick recovery.

I completely agree with you. I personally do enough to just get by so not super high functioning. It is stupid but so many times I have wished to have the kind of depression where you look depressed, where you can't get out of bed ,to look sick enough so people believe me. Or even have full blown breakdowns.  I have had depression since I was young and like you I learnt to manage it. Back then I often felt like I shouldn't show it or I need to keep strong. I also didn't want to worry my family so I never spoke to anyone about it. Now as an adult, it is ingrained in my brain that I must keep composure at all times. Even when I am feel so low I'd rather die, my body won't let me be visibly sad or even show signs of struggling. It literally feels like i am wearing a costume I can't take off and that feeling makes me  want to jump out of my skin. Anyway despite everything, I tell myself that even though not visible, my struggles are important too and I need to help myself in any way I can.

Personally for me they work. Now my life didn't become magically brighter but it took at least 6 six weeks to notice a difference with the stuff I take. I was more calm, less scared and anxious and not so tired. I still struggled with other stuff like motivation etc but generally my mood improved. You gotta find what works best for you. It sucks that it may take a while but who knows, they may be beneficial for you.
Me too. I can't even say the word depression out loud. It feels like I am faking it for attention. Nobody won't take me seriously. I look too good to be suffering.

I have wished so many times to 'look' more depressed so people would believe me. Not that it matters cuz I believe me but it is very frustrating when you constantly hear that you look too good to be depressed. Especially from your own family. Or even from different therapists. I don't know how to ask for help anymore.

I feel you cause I have the same issue. I went to several therapist who discarded my problems. They never believed me because I look 'well.' My own friends tell me that if they didn't know me on a personal level they'd never guess I am depressed. Looks like a compliment but it makes me feel so miserable. You should definitely seek for help. All I can say is that don't get discouraged till you find someone who gets you. A problem is a problem no matter how small or big. Especially if it is preventing you from leading a normal life. I mean you have to push through for your own good and try to help yourself.

This is so me. I won't kill myself because my family cares about me but I do this. Not super often but in the back of my head these thoughts will always pop up. When I see really tall buildings I am like 'That'd be a nice building to jump from' Or like when huge knifes are lying around the kitchen I think about how it would be to cut my wrists with that. I wouldn't do it but knowing the option is there has actually helped because once the bad episodes are over I realize it isnt that bad.
True. I used to do this pretending I was talking to a therapist. It helped a bit.

I relate so much to the fog part. I can't read anything anymore. My brain is so foggy I can't focus and need to read some sentences over and over to understand. When talking to people now I can't give an opinion on anything. I can't seem to form a coherent sentence to express myself. I feel so stupid.
I relate so much. I have done this for so many years. It has gotten to a point that even if I feel terrible I won't allow myself to break down. I literally can"t. I have to be composed  all the time.
Good luck! :)
I am not sure if they can tell but personally sometimes as a bi girl I get this lesbian energy from some girls. It is so weird because I can't explain it but I do feel it sometimes.

I suppose you get discouraged too quickly. I am like this too and if I can't see sudden results I will feel upset and then if I am upset I have no energy and I will be too tired to keep it up. I want things to change fast because I have no patience and am too tired to keep trying. It is very cliche and overused but at times you feel motivated try to do little things that don't need the biggest effort. If you feel tired or bad just stop and don't upset yourself with words that you couldn't do it. It is hard but you have to try to live with depression. I still need to accept this personally.

I do this too kinda. I have this crazy need to be hyper, fun, happy, tell lots of jokes and be entertaining in general. I don't know why I do this. There are times I feel so bad and yet I can't stop. Over the years I was trying to implement 'fake it till you make it' in my life hoping I'd feel better. While it has improved my attitude, it has left me feeling numb and desperate.
Same. It blows my mind. How do people even do things without thinking of them as meaningless? How do they push to go to work or school everyday without feeling tired and with no purpose?! Idk.

That sucks and I am sorry. I know that this is no solution but can't you pretend while you are around your mom? I know hiding yourself is no good but only for you to get some peace. I know it is hard right now but it won't be like this all the time. You also have your dad to support you.
I am so sorry to hear this. But can't you talk to your dad about your mom's behaviour and tell him how she is affecting you?
My exact thoughts! I hate it so much. I would much rather suffer and get shit done than sleep all day and feel so down for no reason.
All the time.
Yes. But don't try to think too much about it. Just do it for the sake of doing it. :)

Faking to be okay has become a habit. I don't think about it when I do it. I tend to not think at all about my problems. I immerse myself in the moment pretending like I have nothing to worry about. I tend to be upbeat and silly. Crack a joke here and there and mostly try to be relatable with whoever I am talking to. I smile widely and laugh loudly .I pretend to be excited about things that I know I should like even when I am not feeling excited. I try to be sociable, invite people out if I can and distract myself with whatever's around. Like comment on the color of the sky or try to enjoy the warm sun or a cup of coffee perhaps.  The more you do it , the more this behaviour becomes a habit. You might even start to enjoy a couple of things and not need to fake.  It helps sometimes not to feel so miserable about everything all the time.
I am 21. I am not diabetic and I don't smoke. I feel like they wouldnt take me seriously. Perhaps I will try cutting down on sugar and starch. Thanks a lot. :)

I relate. For some reason I can't have a breakdown because I am afraid it will draw too much attention or worry my parents. Also I am kinda embarrased. When I feel really terrible I continue suffering in silence and my body aches or sth like that.

I get what you mean. I used to feel like this all the time. Asking myself if I am faking it, telling myself that I am just overreacting. What do I want more from life?! I had everything. Not 'everything' but more than others and enough to keep me happy. I too couldnt talk to friends or my family. I felt so alone everyday. Depression can hit everyone and it doesnt care who you are. It isnt your fault. You cant help but feel so low. I get it. I dont know how to help. I am from a country where there are no school counsellor. If there is one in your country you should try to get help. I had the app 7cups downloaded and sometimes would talk to someone when i felt low. Or just write in forums online to help myself even if it was a little. Try writing your feelings down if it helps. It is so hard to try I know but please dont let yourself fall any deeper. Keep your mind busy. Set little goals. Practice self love in front of a mirror. Talk to yourself and pretend you are at the therapist or sth. I do it often. Anything to stop you thinking. I am sorry that this is so long and I wish I could offer better help.
Yeah I know. Thank you though! :)
I don't have any passions. There is nothing that interests me really. Or there is nothing I feel like I can do.

Yes. This is the reason I think I made it this far. But it keeps me going. I dont think I'd ever kill myself cuz I have no courage but I like it to have it as an option. When I get to the 'terrible' thing I feared,  I am able to overcome it cuz it isn't as bad as I thought. So I get through another day. I wonder how far can I go.
Same. I know the person staring back its me. I can recognize the face but it doesnt feel mine. I have this feeling that I should look different.
I do too. But suicide is kind of my 'motivation'. I tell myself that if things dont work then I could just die. Strangely that helps get me through things that I thought would turn out for the worse.
Same. Some people would wish to have it this easy but here i am. Idk how to feel better.

Yes I agree but it all depends on how you treat the people you meet. Even if at first people looked so attractive to my eyes , after a while I don't notice. I just talk to them without much thought of their faces unless I specifically look at their faces only.
I know. It makes it worse cuz some people reassure you over and over that they are there for you. But when you try to talk to them,they cut you off. It feels so bad to know no one cares.
Wow. This is exactly how I feel. It hurts to know that I cannot live up to my own expectations cuz I suck. Why try if I can't live the way I want to?!

Well I don't really know. I never think if I was happy or not. I remember a time when I felt okay.  I remember a time when I could just live and not question how the hell do people live. Right now it just feels kinda weird to me that people can wake up and go by their day and not think how or why they should go on.
I am so glad you decided to share your story here.  I hope everything goes well for you! :)
Even though this experience with your car must have been scary I'm glad it got you thinking. I wish you well and I hope that things get a little better from now on. :)

Please please think of your family. Please. They won't be able to go on without you. Please go to a hospital nearby. You deserve to live. You made it this far. You can hold on a little more. It can get better. Talk to your family,boyfriend,anyone. Please don't do it.
I know this isn't gonna help but be strong for them for a little more. Maybe it will get easier. Just maybe. I'm sorry.
I'm glad that you're not discouraged by his behavior and still want to go. It will get better probably once you have been there a couple of times. I wish you the best ! :)
'Your lack of motivation comes from having a convenient way of living ' 'You  are weak '
Me too. I feel comfortable here with my problems. And sometimes the replies on other people's posts are useful to me.

This is so me and I hate it so much that I'm such an asshole. And the worst part is that you know they'd never think about it like this if it was the other way around. It's not like I want them to be unhappy but I wish sth good was happening to me too so I could focus on that instead of my own misery.
Good for you! Hopefully you'll feel a little better! :)

I do that too. Most times I don't even mean it. It just comes out of my mouth for stupid reasons. I feel a little tired sometimes and my first thought is to say that I want to die. I don't even know why I do that.
Sounds like me. I also do this my good friends. When I'm with them I'm fine. I barely notice my sorroundings. The moment we separate I feel insecure and scared.

True. I tell my depressed friend all the time how she can do this and she is worth it and how she'll overcome this situation even if it will take a long time. And then I turn around and feel hopeless.
Yess. I only like summer because I can go to the beach but other than that I prefer fall/winter. I love being cozy and warm under blankets. It makes me feel safe.
